intro: Uzbekistan is Central Asia's most populous country, with about 37 million people.

chapters.title: People
text: Most people are Uzbeks, with Tajik, Kazakh, Russian and Karakalpak minorities. Uzbek is a Turkic language, and Russian is widely understood.
Most Uzbeks are Sunni Muslim. The population is young and growing.

chapters.title: Tashkent
text: Tashkent, the capital, is the largest city in Central Asia, rebuilt after a 1966 earthquake.

keyTerms.meaning: An autonomous republic in western Uzbekistan.
